name: bloodsoaked_altar_sacrifices_a_creature_you_control_not_one_you_own
notes: Printed: 'Sacrifice a creature' (one you control, CR 701.21a). The controller owns a Yoked Ox the opponent controls (it cannot be sacrificed) and controls a Leafkin Druid the opponent owns (it is the only candidate): the Druid is sacrificed (to its owner's graveyard) and the owned Ox stays on the battlefield.
